# xLogger

> Header-only, leveled logger for Arduino and PlatformIO (C++11; AVR, ESP32, ESP8266, RP2040, SAMD), aimed at beginners. Log with logger.error/warn/info/debug(...), passing values as comma-separated arguments like Serial.print (no String concatenation; F() for literals on AVR). Levels above the XLOGGER_MAX_LEVEL build flag are removed from the firmware. XLOG_* macros are an advanced alternative that also skip argument evaluation; XLOG_HERE prints function and line.

## Docs

- [Complete AI reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuriCirino/xlogger/main/llms-full.txt): rules, API, patterns and anti-patterns in one file. Read this before writing code with xLogger.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuriCirino/xlogger/main/README.md): overview, installation and API table.
- [Agent Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuriCirino/xlogger/main/skills/xlogger/SKILL.md): same reference packaged as an Agent Skill (SKILL.md).
- [Library header](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuriCirino/xlogger/main/src/xLogger.h): the full source, about 150 lines.

## Examples

- [Basic](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuriCirino/xlogger/main/examples/Basic/Basic.ino): all levels, mixed argument types, XLOG_HERE.
- [LevelsAndTags](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuriCirino/xlogger/main/examples/LevelsAndTags/LevelsAndTags.ino): runtime level changes, tags, timestamps, one logger per module.
- [CompileTimeStrip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuriCirino/xlogger/main/examples/CompileTimeStrip/CompileTimeStrip.ino): release build without debug/info.
- [PlatformIO project](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuriCirino/xlogger/main/extras/platformio-example/platformio.ini): debug and release environments.
